name: Space
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign Creator of the heavens and the earth, establishing the vast expanse of space as His handiwork from the very beginning (Genesis 1:1, 2:1). The celestial bodies, including stars like Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, serve specific purposes such as providing light upon the earth (Genesis 1:15; Job 9:9). The Bible also emphasizes God's power and authority over the universe, describing how He stretches out the north over empty space and suspends the earth without support (Job 26:7), affirming that all things in space exist under His command and design.
